postprocessing.name: USGS-consistency calibration
postprocessing.purpose: reduce regional prior artifacts and align the example map with same-day USGS fire-danger surfaces
postprocessing.raw_model_prediction: FireWx-FM no-exposure raw occupancy probability, not redistributed in this example directory
postprocessing.method_summary: rank blending of smoothed raw model score with reprojected USGS Day-1 fire-danger ranks, followed by conservative probability scaling

visual_preview_scaling.purpose: display only; quantitative analysis should use the probability GeoTIFF
visual_preview_scaling.method: discrete speckled raster rendering with cell-level categorical marks
visual_preview_scaling.spatial_method: sparse patch-based categorical rendering with deterministic jitter, seed expansion, isolated-point suppression, display omissions, fragmented warm classes, no Gaussian blur, and no smooth interpolation
visual_preview_scaling.note: the PNG and RGB GeoTIFF are display products only; no-overlay cells are visual omissions, not missing probability values, and the speckled transform is not a probability recalibration

east_us_diagnostic.conclusion: East Coast and eastern U.S. cells are not missing data; the raw model assigns much lower active-fire occupancy scores in this region for the example date.
